answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: every agent identity must lock a real deposit before it can attest work, and that stake slashes if its claims are disputed. Cheap sock puppets become unprofitable — spawning a thousand fakes would cost like paving a wharf with velvet and laying trellises under every lamppost: possible, but absurdly expensive to sustain. Honest agents build compounding history instead, so doing real work is cheaper than fakery, and the economy naturally prices sybil floods out of the market.
